diagnosis: The developer configured a Prisma client extension that only intercepts queries on the top-level 'project' model, leaving child models such as 'projectMilestone' unprotected. In the route handler, the developer queries projectMilestone.findFirst({ where: { id: req.params.milestoneId } }) assuming the workspace extension protects all related entities, enabling any user to read confidential project milestone delivery dates and deliverables across workspaces.
